item.title: Muhammad Ali, Phillis Wheatley Join More Than 100 Prominent Black Figures on USPS Stamps
item.description: Compiled by The Birmingham Times For 2026, the U.S. Postal Service (USPS) is featuring prominent Black figures on stamps, notably Phillis Wheatley, the first published African American poet, as the 49th Black Heritage stamp, and the legendary boxer Muhammad Ali.
